# Research Overview: AI-Core Mobile Apps for High-Frequency Women's Activities

## Executive Summary

Across 4 tournament rounds we generated, peer-reviewed, and evolved 24 hypotheses (12 survive, 6 killed on review, 6 archived as duplicates), with every novelty claim independently re-verified against Perplexity-grounded competitor searches. The idea space converged hard on a single dominant pattern, and the top 5 ideas all instantiate it. **The winning pattern: one sharp still photo → a personalized, JUDGMENTAL verdict on MY specific item/body/case, delivered at a recurring moment nobody currently owns, with a compounding personal-context moat and a screenshot-worthy verdict card that doubles as the ad.** The hardest cross-cutting finding is the Mechanism Law: real-time fine-grained live-video coaching is not feasible today, so single-still "snapshot judgment" beat live coaching in every head-to-head and is the technical foundation of the entire roadmap.

## Top-5 Detailed Profiles

### #1 — BraidCheck Snapshot Coach (Elo 1275.6)

**What it is.** An at-home braiding and protective-styling coach. The user snaps ONE still per step; the AI grades it against the target style — part straightness, section evenness, symmetry, gross tension — and returns the next-step fix. A "mom-styling-daughter morning mode" is retained as a retention *mode*, not a standalone product.

**Why it wins on NOVELTY × USERBASE.** It hits the largest credible everyday-female cohort in the top 5 (~60-80M US women style hair at home; DIY-braiders 2-5x/week) inside fully verified white space. It won the title bout against LatchLens.

**Named-competitor evidence.** Every incumbent is either a virtual try-on filter (YouCam, VEED) or a static tutorial. None critique hair in progress — the checkpoint-critique loop is the wedge.

**Mechanism + feasibility.** Single sharp stills sidestep the dead real-time-video problem. Coarse braid-grading is the right granularity, but it is unproven on benchmarks and must be validated.

**Moat.** A compounding personal style/technique history plus a screenshot-worthy "I did this myself" verdict card.

**Growth + $1-5M path.** #braidtok reels where the output *is* the ad; freemium $7-10/mo + affiliate; $1-5M reachable at 30-50k subs.

**Top risks.** (1) Coarse braid-grading accuracy unproven; (2) texture-diversity (4A-4C) data is both an execution and an ethics gate; (3) try-on incumbents could bolt on critique.

**First validation step.** Wizard-of-Oz live-coach test + label N checkpoint stills against stylist ground truth (stylist-agreement study).

### #2 — GlowCheck (Elo 1231.9)

**What it is.** A self-tan application checker. One still in the fixable develop window → a body-map fault verdict (streaks, missed zones, over-developing) + fix actions.
